title: [Bard Guild, Circular Chamber]
description: An expansive circular chamber provides an impressive entry to the Bard Guild, with a carved wooden door leading out.  The walls are decorated with narrow silk hangings, and the ceiling above is high, with ceiling fans suspended on long shafts floating like a flight of birds.  Tall palm trees potted in urns circle the room's perimeter, placed around the edge of a round rug woven in brilliant tones of red, gold, and indigo blue.  A carved lebbek arch sits between two ocean blue silk banners stitched with golden musical notes.
